title: The Missing Sea-Glass Jar
scene: At 1:20 PM, the rare sea-glass jar vanished from the pier gallery. The 1:00 PM tram takes 30 minutes to reach Sunset Cove.

suspects.name: Celia Kemp
suspects.testimony: I labeled shells right beside the gallery counter from 1:05 to 1:25 PM.
suspects.alibiProof: A visiting couple chatted with Celia beside the gallery counter from 1:05 to 1:25 PM.

suspects.name: Harriet Nash
suspects.testimony: I glazed mugs in the courtyard from 1:00 to 1:25 PM and never stepped inside the gallery.
suspects.alibiProof: Two tourists photographed Harriet glazing mugs in the courtyard from 1:00 to 1:25 PM.

suspects.name: Darius Moon
suspects.testimony: I boarded the 1:00 PM tram and was already collecting driftwood at Sunset Cove by 1:15 PM.
suspects.contradiction: The 1:00 PM tram doesn't reach Sunset Cove until 1:30 PM, and the sea-glass jar was in Darius's pack.

suspects.name: Rowan Burke
suspects.testimony: I mended nets on the lower jetty from 1:00 to 1:30 PM, watching the tide roll in.
suspects.alibiProof: The dock warden shared lunch with Rowan on the lower jetty from 1:00 to 1:30 PM.
